|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “USED: If your alien bounty hunter (except Fett) is in battle at a site with opponent's smuggler, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny. LOST: If your alien bounty hunter is in battle at a site, draws two battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “USED: During battle at a site where your alien bounty hunter (except Boba Fett) is with opponent’s smuggler, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny.<br />LOST: During a battle at a site where you have an alien bounty hunter, add one battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' “If” → “During battle at a site where”; added “Boba”; removed “in battle at a site”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “destiny. LOST: If your alien bounty hunter is in” → “destiny.<br />LOST: During a”; “site, draws two” → “site where you have an alien bounty hunter, add one”; “destiny if not able to otherwise.” → “destiny.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 42. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?]].
* Later text: [[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
